metadata.warning_definition: First unsafe TTC/closest-distance trend on a shared unshielded prefix, assessed offline in truth. Not expired S03 and not an operational online trigger.
metadata.comparison_clock: Every branch ends 30 executed steps after the same warning; pre-takeover violations/rewards are included. No reset of S03 history.
metadata.nominal_policy: fixed rule_agnostic_policy; shield ablation, not learned-policy evaluation
metadata.reference_definition: 82 fixed 3-step sequences plus multi-start full-truth SLSQP max-min sampled separation with physically valid state and restored safety at step 3; validated in actual environment, not certified global upper bound.
